Etymoasis word data
===================

Files: /data/etymoasis-data.json (download), and the same data in the site's pages and scripts:
Latin and Greek roots, prefixes, suffixes, assimilation examples, eponyms, doublets and word
origin myths.

Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Attribution: Etymoasis (https://etymoasis.me/). The meanings, origins and examples were written for
Etymoasis and checked against, and in part derived from, Wiktionary (https://en.wiktionary.org/),
whose text is by Wiktionary contributors under CC BY-SA 4.0. Every entry links the Wiktionary page it
was checked against; the edit history of each page lists its authors.

You may share and adapt the data, including commercially, if you give appropriate credit (for
example "Etymoasis, data from Wiktionary contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0"), link to the licence, say if you
made changes, and release what you build from it under the same licence.

The data is provided as is, without warranty. Word origins are often uncertain; check the linked
sources before relying on an entry.

Not covered by this licence:
- /data/english-words.txt, a list of everyday English words from SCOWL (Spell Checker Oriented Word
  Lists), Copyright 2000-2016 by Kevin Atkinson, used by the root breaker to recognise whole English
  words. Its own notice is in /data/LICENSE-SCOWL.txt.
- The site's code, design and fonts.
